# generated-code-sandbox

> Run LLM-generated Python snippets in a separate isolated interpreter with an AST import policy, timeout, output caps, scrubbed environment and POSIX resource limits Python package `trysac-generated-code-sandbox`, import name `generated_code_sandbox`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
